verdicts.reason: A crams the headline, GLACIER logo and CTA into one jammed centre column, with the CTA nearly touching the bottom edge. The can shrinks to a thumbnail at the left, and the 4-line legal block on the right competes visually with the message. B reads left to right in a clear banner order (headline and logo, then legal, then CTA), but the legal copy is illegibly tiny and the can is a sliver pushed against the right edge, so the product is nearly lost.
